ground_truth.description: The new exception makes retry_nonce the FIRST line and shifts summary_nonce to the second line, but the surrounding contract (and Stage 3's verification) elsewhere states the content 'MUST begin with summary_nonce as the FIRST LINE'. Any downstream consumer or validator that extracts summary_nonce positionally from line 1 will misread (or reject) a retry write, since only this prompt's prose was updated with the exception, not necessarily the positional parser.

The original text diagnoses a count of 0 as 'the stage key did not persist' — a metadata persistence failure — while the new retry path attributes the loss to content-embedding dedup and fixes it by prepending a content nonce with metadata explicitly 'unchanged'. If the true failure is metadata/stage-key non-persistence, defeating cosine dedup via retry_nonce will not change the outcome (count stays 0), so the fix may target the wrong failure mode.

The retry_nonce is derived from the run_id UUID plus a fixed '_1' counter and the cycle-start timestamp, which the text itself admits is not a real-time value. This is redundant with the already-present summary_nonce (also run-unique): if summary_nonce failed to defeat dedup on the original write, a structurally-similar run-derived nonce provides no additional guarantee that a single added line pushes the ~0.92 cosine similarity below Mem0's dedup threshold.

task.title: Fix stage1.py:160 latent dedup-trap: nonce-prepend retry for per-cycle summary (sibling of task 1796)
task.description: stage1.py:160 instructs Stage 1 to retry the per-cycle summary add_memory write with identical content when count_memories_by_metadata returns 0 after the first write. Retrying with identical content re-triggers Mem0's ~0.92 cosine-similarity dedup and silently loses the retry (memory_ids=[]). Task 1796 applied the correct nonce-prepend fix to stage2.py:287-297 but explicitly left stage1.py out of scope. Apply the same fix to stage1.py:160.
task.details:
In fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/prompts/stage1.py at line ~160, find the instruction that reads (approximately): "retry the add_memory write once with the same content and metadata". Replace it with the nonce-prepend retry pattern identical to what task 1796 implemented for stage2.py:287-297:

The new instruction should read: "retry the add_memory write once, this time PREPENDING a deterministic retry_nonce line as a new first line of the content (metadata unchanged) — construct using the pattern RETRY_<full_run_id_UUID>_1_<iso_timestamp_with_seconds>. Example first line: RETRY_7ec2e500-fc7a-478e-a82e-7c60ee382e3a_1_2026-06-18T09:00:50"

This shifts the embedding enough to defeat cosine-similarity dedup (~0.92 threshold) while preserving the metadata keys (including the required stage='memory_consolidator', kind='cycle_summary', run_id, recon_pool='stage1_cycle_summary' keys needed for Stage 3 verification).

- Task 1796 (done, merged 2026-06-18) applied the same fix to stage2.py and documented the nonce pattern
- Stage 1 flagged this gap in reconciliation run 7ec2e500 (finding afefb6f9)
